summary.headline: Saturn’s Portents in Annual Revolutions
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Saturn in annual revolutions: its angularity, retrogradation, cadency, reception, aspects, and placement in watery signs signify cold, winds, infirmity, earthquakes, lawsuits, locusts, discord, death, and rain. The book of Messahala on the revolutions of the years of the world concludes.
